description:
FitPulse: Global fitness intelligence API. Evidence-based workout programming, nutrition science, supplement efficacy analysis, injury recovery protocols, race training plans, sleep optimization, plateau-breaki

Coverage: Global

Endpoints:
  • workout ($0.10): Custom workout plan
  • exercise ($0.08): Exercise form guide
  • nutrition ($0.10): Macro and nutrition targets
  • supplement ($0.08): Evidence-based supplement analysis
  • recover ($0.10): Injury recovery protocol
  • supplements ($0.08): Evidence-graded supplement efficacy tier list by goal
  • rehab ($0.10): Sports medicine rehabilitation protocol
  • sleep ($0.08): Athletic sleep optimization and CBT-I protocol
  • plateau ($0.10): Training plateau analysis and breakthrough protocol
  • race ($0.10): Race training plan built backwards from event date

action.description: Which endpoint to call. Options: workout | exercise | nutrition | supplement | recover | supplements | rehab | sleep | plateau | race

current_fitness.description: Current fitness level and recent training context

current_routine.description: Brief description of current training and diet approach

equipment.description: e.g. full gym, dumbbells-only, bodyweight (default: full gym)

goal.description: e.g. muscle-gain, fat-loss, strength, endurance, general-fitness

injury.description: e.g. sprained-ankle, pulled-hamstring, rotator-cuff, shin-splints, runners-knee

issue.description: Sleep issue (e.g. trouble falling asleep, early waking, poor recovery despite sleep, jet-lag)

race_date.description: Race date (YYYY-MM-DD) — plan is built backwards from this date

race_type.description: Race type (5K, 10K, half-marathon, marathon, triathlon-sprint, triathlon-olympic, ironman, OCR)

restrictions.description: Dietary restrictions or intolerances (vegan, lactose-free, etc.)

sport.description: Target sport or activity for return-to-sport phase

training_schedule.description: Training schedule context (e.g. morning workouts, evening training, two-a-days)

weeks_stuck.description: How many weeks the plateau has lasted (e.g. 6)

name: fitpulse
